unverified_failsafe.description: Applied when the active model is not explicitly specified or verified by the user. Treats all articles >= 02.25 as Dynamic Tier 1 (Post-Cutoff Delta) to eliminate pre-2025 syntax regressions.

tier_1_post_cutoff.label: Dynamic Tier 1 (Post-Cutoff Delta)
tier_1_post_cutoff.description: Released after the active model's training cutoff. Zero pre-training exposure.

tier_2_boundary_maturation.label: Dynamic Tier 2 (Cutoff-Boundary & Maturation Window)
tier_2_boundary_maturation.description: Released within 12 months leading up to the model's cutoff where pre-training coverage may be incomplete or Preview-to-GA syntax transitions occurred.

tier_3_timeless_foundation.label: Dynamic Tier 3 (Absorbed & Timeless Foundations)
tier_3_timeless_foundation.description: Already absorbed into weights for newest models; consulted selectively for timeless mathematical FinOps crossover proofs and core RFCs.

gemini-4-argon.notes: Newest frontier reasoning generation (Cutoff: March 2026). Dynamic Tier 1 covers >= 04.26; Dynamic Tier 2 covers 03.25 - 03.26.

gemini-3.8-flash.notes: Previous generation high-throughput Flash model (Cutoff: March 2026). Dynamic Tier 1 covers >= 04.26; Dynamic Tier 2 covers 03.25 - 03.26.

gemini-3.1-pro.notes: Older generation Pro model (Cutoff: January 2025). Dynamic Tier 1 covers all releases >= 02.25.
